title: Internship Intelligence
summary: A human-reviewed AI workflow for organizing recruitment emails, application records, and upcoming deadlines.
problem: Internship updates arrive across multiple emails. Manually maintaining application stages and deadlines creates repetitive work and opportunities for missed actions.
approach: Normalize Gmail messages with JavaScript and record them in an email log.
Use Gemini to extract structured information into a review queue.
Keep approval and application-sheet updates manual in the current MVP.
Build separate n8n workflows for calendar synchronization and a digest of deadlines in the next three days.
outcome: Four locally built MVP workflows cover application intake, AI email extraction, calendar synchronization, and deadline digests. Sanitized workflow exports and setup documentation are available in the repository.
limitations: This is a local Docker MVP, not a verified 24/7 autonomous deployment. Approved review records require manual transfer. Changed deadlines and multiple calendar events per application are not yet supported.
status: Local MVP · Human in the loop

title: AutoSIEM
summary: A security analytics prototype bringing machine learning and generative AI into fraud investigation.
problem: High transaction volumes make manual fraud triage difficult. Analysts need useful signals and readable context to support investigations.
approach: Explore transaction behavior and balance-related features.
Build an XGBoost fraud classifier with Optuna hyperparameter optimization.
Use Gemini to support human-readable alert summaries and investigation timelines.
Visualize fraud patterns, suspicious accounts, and transaction drilldowns with Plotly.
outcome: The team prototype received an Honorable Mention at the UGM DCSE Summer Course 2025. The repository documents the model approach and dashboard concepts for security investigation.
limitations: A course prototype rather than an operational security service. Reported classifier accuracy alone does not establish real-world fraud detection quality or a production false-positive rate.
